comment: Paths scripts/check-no-em-dash.mjs skips. A trailing slash means the whole directory, and * matches within one path segment. Every entry needs a one-line reason. Add to this list only for evidence, verbatim third-party captures, or text where the character is functional.

vendored.reason: Third-party model assets; pii/tokenizer.json is model vocabulary and must match the upstream weights.

evidence.reason: Committed evidence; must stay byte-identical (includes the Wave7 core-latency.json and Lighthouse reports).
Gate board; values are evidence and must stay byte-identical.
Byte copy of Guardrails/guardrails.json written by scripts/build_documents.py.
Release gate status record read by scripts/check_release.py; gate reasons are evidence.
Held-out benchmark inputs; editing them would change measured results.
Verbatim third-party source captures (official SIH pages, reference chats, scraped docs); quotes must stay exact.
Honesty strings are emitted verbatim into Benchmarks/results/score-path-heldout-v01.json.
Strings are emitted verbatim into Benchmarks/results/core-latency.json.
Strings are emitted verbatim into Benchmarks/results/e2e.json.
G08 mapping strings are emitted verbatim into Benchmarks/results/hardening.json.
Strings are emitted verbatim into Benchmarks/results/load.json.
